data.body:
FIX SHAPE — and why it is deliberately NOT "fail health when the store is missing".

The obvious reading of this ticket is "make /health fail when there is no store". That would be
actively dangerous to land right now, and the reason is worth recording.

The production box TODAY has no store (sibling ticket kilted-nuclear-bronco). /health is BOTH the
container HEALTHCHECK (Dockerfile.mcp:56-57) and the blue-green readiness gate
(autodeploy.sh:130). So a health check that fails on a missing store would, on the very next
deploy, mark the currently-SERVING mcp container unhealthy, cause autodeploy to refuse promotion,
and — with `restart: always` — put the boot container into a restart loop. The endpoint works
today; a change whose purpose is to REPORT a problem must not be the thing that causes an outage.

So the shape is:

1. /health REPORTS store status and keeps returning 200:
     {"in_flight": N, "store": {"path": ..., "present": bool, "expected": bool}}
   `expected` is true only when a tracker dir is EXPLICITLY configured. That is the discriminator
   the ticket's AC1 asks for — "distinguishes serving with a usable store from serving with no
   store" — without conflating "this deployment has no store" with "this deployment is broken".

2. The autodeploy readiness gate enforces `store.present` only when `store.expected` is true.
   Today mcp sets no tracker dir => expected=false => the gate is INERT and nothing can break.
   Once kilted-nuclear-bronco sets REBAR_TRACKER_DIR => expected=true => the gate becomes strict
   automatically, with no second change and no flag day.

3. Boot logs one line naming the store path and whether it was found (AC2). Today
   mcp_server.py:759-761 guards the ensure-sweep with `if os.path.isdir(_tracker)` and emits
   NOTHING when absent — the comment at :752 ("a missing store ... never aborts boot") is a
   reasonable posture, but combined with a health probe that cannot see the store it is why this
   failure went unobserved since deployment. Keep the log-and-continue posture; just make it say
   something.

This makes the two tickets order-independent by construction: whichever lands first, neither can
break the box. That is the point of keying on `expected` rather than on presence alone.
